description: This file contains private declarations for the lm wrapper component, including function prototypes related to stopping scans, retrieving LAN host comments, setting LAN host comments, and obtaining Ethernet port information. It primarily serves as a private header defining interfaces for internal use within the lm wrapper module.

methods.name: lm_wrapper_priv_stop_scan
methods.description: Stops the ongoing scan process within the lm wrapper module.

methods.name: lm_wrapper_priv_getLanHostComments
methods.description: Retrieves comments associated with a LAN host given its physical address.

methods.name: lm_wrapper_priv_set_lan_host_comments
methods.description: Sets comments for a LAN host using the provided command structure.

methods.name: lm_wrapper_priv_getEthernetPort
methods.description: Obtains information about the Ethernet port associated with a specified MAC address.
